runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle, blind to the change)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.limitation: The scenario's input tuple (champions, levels, items, target armor, fight window) is defined outside the exported tree, so this is a mechanism-and-magnitude derivation from the cached wiki constants, not a bit-exact re-simulation of the leaf.

sources_quoted.text: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).
sources_quoted.reading: Expose Weakness is a debuff ON THE TARGET amplifying damage 'from all sources' -> in a coupled roster it must amplify every participant's damage, not only the Bloodsong holder's. Amp magnitude 8% (melee holder) / 5% (ranged holder).

sources_quoted.text: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
sources_quoted.reading: 6 percentage points of armor REDUCTION per stack, 5 stacks, 30% cap. Corroborated by data/item-atoms/3071.json (damage.resistance-mitigation / stack.gain) and data/atoms/items.json 3071 values [6.0 s, 5 stacks, 6%, 30%].

sources_quoted.path: data/items.json -> "3153" (Blade of the Ruined King) .passives[0] ("Mist's Edge") .branches[0]
sources_quoted.text: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage on-hit equal to {{rd|9%|6%}} of the target's current health
sources_quoted.reading: Witness for the {{rd|melee|ranged}} argument order (BotRK is 9% melee / 6% ranged), fixing Bloodsong's 8% as the melee-holder value and 5% as the ranged-holder value.

sources_quoted.text: post = raw * m(R), m(R) = 100/(100+R); R_final = max(0, (R - r_flat)*(1 - r_pct/100)*(1 - p) - f)
sources_quoted.reading: Armor reduction (Carve) applies before percent and flat penetration; penetration floors at 0. Used for the armor-side bound below.

sources_quoted.text: the established model uses a fixed 0.8*max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch) ... the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C - C(C-1)/(2h) for h >= C; the constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos and deviates by up to +/-20% at the extremes
sources_quoted.reading: Bounds ANY legitimate change of the modelled average Carve stack count: constant 0.8*5 = 4.0 stacks vs Cesaro 5 - 10/h in [3.0, 5.0). The largest attainable delta in modelled stacks is < 1 stack = < 6 percentage points of armor reduction.

sources_quoted.path: data/champions.json + CLAUDE.md growth formula base + growth*(L-1)*(0.7025 + 0.0175*(L-1))
sources_quoted.text: level-18 base armor across the roster: min = Thresh 33.0 (zero growth, soul-scaling), next lowest Anivia 88.7, max = Sejuani 126.7
sources_quoted.reading: Any level-18 target other than a soul-less Thresh carries >= ~88 base armor before items.

observed_ratio.note: leaf values are printed to 0.1, so the true ratio lies in [305.55/282.45, 305.65/282.35]

step_2_armor_side_exclusion.model: A physical source's total scales as m(R) = 100/(100+R). With Carve reduction applied before penetration (S4), a change of dk modelled stacks changes post-%pen armor u = A*(1-p) by 0.06*dk*u, so gain = 1 + 0.06*dk*u / (100 + max(0, u*(1-0.06*k_new) - f)).
step_2_armor_side_exclusion.bound_from_S5: dk < 1 stack for any documented model change (constant 4.0 -> Cesaro 5 - 10/h < 5.0).
step_2_armor_side_exclusion.worked_bound: gain >= 1.0822 with dk = 1 requires 0.06*u >= 8.215 -> u >= 136.9 AND the post-shred armor to be fully penetrated (0.70*u <= f) -> f >= 95.9 flat penetration. Flat pen near 96 is unreachable in an ordinary SR build, and unreachable at all in a build that already spends a slot on Black Cleaver.
step_2_armor_side_exclusion.full_debuff_variant: If instead the ENTIRE Carve shred first became visible to this source (0 -> 24% or 0 -> 30%), the ratio (100+A)/(100+A*(1-s)) equals 1.0822 only at A = 46.3 (s=0.24) or A = 33.9 (s=0.30), and OVERSHOOTS badly for any larger A. Per S6 the only level-18 champion under 88 armor is Thresh at exactly 33.0, which yields 133.0/123.1 = 1.08042 -> 282.4*1.08042 = 305.1, outside the rounding window for 305.6.
step_2_armor_side_exclusion.conclusion: No armor/Carve-side change can produce the observed +8.22%. The change is dominated by a damage AMPLIFIER of ~8%.

independent_computation.step_3_identification: The only amplifier published by either namesake item is Bloodsong's Expose Weakness: 8% (melee holder) / 5% (ranged holder) increased damage from ALL SOURCES (S1). 1.0822 = 1.08 x 1.0020: an 8% amp plus a <=0.2% residual, which is exactly the size of a sub-stack Carve difference (0.06*dk*u ~ 0.5 armor at u ~ 200, i.e. dk ~ 0.04 - the Cesaro-vs-constant gap at h ~ 10 hits per S5) or of coupled-timeline granularity. The alternative reading 1.0822 = 1.05 x 1.0306 (ranged holder plus one extra Carve stack, e.g. u = 65 after 35% pen with f = 18) is also internally consistent; both readings put the amp INSIDE the new value and neither can produce it from the old value without one.
independent_computation.step_4_over_application_check: A double application of Expose Weakness would show +16.6%, and a spuriously added full 30% Carve shred would show +15% to +25% at level-18 armors. The observed +8.22% is a single application at the item's published magnitude - the new value is not an over-count.
independent_computation.derived_correct_value: 282.4 x 1.08 = 305.0 (melee Expose Weakness), matching the new leaf 305.6 to 0.20%; the old leaf 282.4 carries no Expose Weakness amplification at all (7.6% low).

verdict_rationale: Bloodsong's Expose Weakness is a target debuff that, in the wiki's own words, makes the target 'take 8%/5% increased damage from all sources'. In a coupled roster scenario every participant's damage against that target must therefore be amplified. The leaf moved by a factor of 1.0822, which no Carve/armor-side effect can reach (step 2) and which matches a single application of the 8% amplifier to within 0.2%. The old value 282.4 equals the un-amplified figure and is inconsistent with 'from all sources'; the new value 305.6 is consistent with the cached wiki text.
confidence: high on direction and on the ~8% amplifier being the operative term; medium on bit-exactness - the scenario's roster is outside the exported evidence, so the residual 0.20% (and the melee-vs-ranged choice of 8% vs 5% for the Bloodsong holder) could not be pinned. If the roster's Bloodsong holder is RANGED, the correct amp is 5% and the residual would have to come from a ~3% Carve-stack term; that reading also lands on the new value, not the old one.
